com.bulwark.reformat.notes: Transcribing is much faster (a 30 minute episode in about a minute) and shows live progress; the first-time setup no longer sits for minutes. Reframe: a multicam sequence named 2-up, 3-up, 2-box or 3-box is treated as the wide shot.

com.bulwark.captiontools.notes: This panel has moved: captions are now a tab in the one Bulwark Premiere Tools panel (update Bulwark Vertical Reformat to get it).
